capabilities: fetch reminders from Apple Reminders lists into code blocks
create and complete reminders from Obsidian
filter reminders by date and priority
sync reminder data on a configurable interval
extras: Only works on Apple devices since it syncs via AppleScript; nested/indented reminders are unsupported, and the README warns the author is not responsible for data loss while noting the plugin only alters reminder properties, never deletes reminders.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or manage reminders stored in the Apple Reminders app from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: A plugin to attempt to bring Apple Reminders into Obsidian.
Using Svelte (like how the obsidian-todoist-plugin is doing it. Many Thanks!)

summary: Brings Apple Reminders into notes via code blocks that display, create, and complete reminders, syncing through AppleScript on Apple devices.
